title: USE OF FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION COMMUNICATIONS SYSTEM

sections.title: Scope
sections.content: This part describes the kinds of messages that may be transmitted or relayed by FAA Flight Service Stations.

sections.title: Kinds of messages accepted or relayed
Limitation of liability
sections.content: The United States is not liable for any omission, error, or delay in transmitting or relaying, or for any failure to transmit or relay, any message accepted for transmission or relayed under this part, even if the omission, error, delay, or failure to transmit or relay is caused by the negligence of an employee of the United States.
